analysis: The PR modifies only docs/developer/test.md. The patch changes the 'Last updated' date (line 3), CI documentation on job routing (GPU shards no longer described as running on Blacksmith, around head lines 1432-1433), and test description text about job-size checks (head lines 2056-2061). No source code, protocol, crypto, attestation, authorization, cache, or key-handling behavior changes. The supplied base text (lines 1-926) does not include the changed regions, which sit at base lines ~1432 and ~2057, outside the supplied excerpts, so I judged them from the patch excerpt only. That excerpt is truncated and the CI-runner statement change is documentation of CI routing outside the provider threat model's scope (TB-002, TB-003, TB-007, TB-011, T-041). T-041 was supplied as a relevant definition, but the visible text mentions only test instructions for SSD test volumes (DARKBLOOM_SSD_TEST_TMPDIR), which are unchanged in this PR. The doc keeps guidance to never use production cache roots/keys or live state. One unverified contract: if the underlying CI workflows changed (moving GPU shards from Blacksmith to routed Macs), that would be a supply-chain/CI trust change, but no workflow files are supplied, so nothing can be concluded. No findings.
